title: Best OP Auto Farm Auto Collect Auto Sell Leaf Blower Vacuum
features:
Ronix Hub - Clean all the leaves

Collecting
- Auto Collect with an adjustable delay from 20ms to 300ms
- Auto Leaf Vacuum, Auto Leaf Mower and Auto Leaf Blower, each with its own toggle
- Blower aims at an X and Z point you set with two sliders
- Manual Vacuum Now, Start Mower, Stop Mower and Stop Blowing buttons

Selling
- Auto Sell walks you to the nearest dumpster when your bag hits your threshold
- Sell At % slider from 1 to 100 plus a Sell Now button
- Auto Use Funnel plus a manual Use Funnel button

Upgrades
- Auto Buy Player Upgrades up to a target level per stat
- Bag, Speed, Cash and Gems each pick their own target from 1 to 5
- Manual buy buttons for bag capacity, walk speed, cash bonus and gems bonus
- Tool upgrade buttons for hand, rake and blower

Tools
- Auto Equip Tool plus one-click equip for all 8 tools
- Buy Rake, Leaf Blower and Molotov with in-game cash

Combat
- Auto Molotov and Auto Snowball throw on a cooldown
- Manual throw buttons for both

Boosts
- Auto Use Boosts
- Cash, Gems, Luck and Roll boost buttons
- Buy 2x Cash and 2x Leaves gamepass buttons

Extras
- Auto Complete Tutorial
- Live status for leaves, cash, diamonds, class, bag percentage, upgrade levels, gamepasses, tools and vents
- Zone, class and quest reference tabs
- Unlock Cursor toggle and a clean Stop Script

Ronix WindUI, mobile friendly. Key system, get your key and support at discord.gg/ronixstudios.
